why: The three calls are the check's own entry points calling each other: actsForThePerson asks aRaiseCarriesIt, aRaiseCarriesIt asks mayPressForThePerson, and theSecretaryActingForThePerson asks actsForThePerson. Every door that asks one of them reaches these calls. The doors named are the record door's, as they were when these calls were in records.ts; the doors of every other file that asks the check are named in that file's own entry.
